0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Boston Celtics (3-1, 3rd in the East, on a three-game winning streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Chicago 1-2 on the road and Boston 3-0 at home. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain (back soreness), Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness. The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 134-99 loss in Boston on October 26, and they lost their 2025-26 series with Boston 1-2.
